intro: This unit tells stories about Confucius. He was a teacher in China long ago. He was poor when he was young. He loved to learn his whole life.
You will meet his students. You will hear what he taught about manners and kindness. You will learn about the book of his sayings, the Analects.
By the end, you can tell his story. You can name two of his students. You can explain one of his teachings in your own words.
bigQuestion: What can we learn from the stories of Confucius, the teacher?

timeline.t: A boy named Kong is born in Lu, in old China
His father dies, and his mother raises him
He works simple jobs, like counting grain
At fifteen, he sets his heart on learning
He becomes a teacher for rich and poor
Students like Yan Hui and Zilu learn from him
He tells Zigong to treat others as he wants to be treated
His students write his words in the Analects

words.d: a teacher who lived in China about 2,500 years ago
the Chinese name for Confucius; it means Master Kong
the book of Confucius's sayings, written down by his students
finding out new things and getting better at them
a person who is learning from a teacher
good manners and customs that show respect
showing that you think someone matters
treating others the way you want to be treated

test.why: Confucius was a teacher in China about 2,500 years ago.

test.q: What was the name of his home state?
test.why: Confucius lived in the state of Lu.

test.q: What did Confucius set his heart on at fifteen?
test.why: Analects 2.4 says he set his heart on learning at fifteen.
His students and their students wrote down his words.

test.q: Which student stayed happy with one bowl of rice?
test.why: Analects 6.9 praises Yan Hui for staying joyful.
Li means good manners and customs that show respect.

test.q: Who asked for one word to live by?
What happens in Taiwan on September 28?
test.why: Taiwan keeps Teachers' Day on Confucius's birthday.

test.q: Why did Confucius learn many simple jobs?
test.why: In Analects 9.6 he says he was poor when young.

test.q: What did Confucius teach about treating others?
choices: Do not do to others what you would not want done to you
test.why: That is his teaching in Analects 15.23.

write.prompt: Tell or draw: What made Confucius a good teacher? Use two stories from this unit, like Analects 7.7 (he taught rich and poor) and Analects 15.23 (his answer to Zigong).
tips: Say 'Confucius taught...' when you tell his ideas.
Use one unit word, like li or reciprocity.
Draw a picture if it helps you.
